title: Lebanese Manakish Zaatar
summary: Warm flatbreads baked with fragrant za'atar and olive oil until the edges turn golden and crisp.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and 2 tbsp oil into a soft dough.
Knead 8 minutes and leave covered for 60 minutes until puffy.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Heat oven to 230°C with a tray inside.
Divide dough into four balls and roll into thin rounds; mix za'atar with extra virgin olive oil.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spread za'atar oil over each round, leaving a narrow border.
Bake on hot tray for 8–10 minutes until blistered; cool briefly.

tips: A preheated tray helps the bases bake crisp rather than doughy.
variations: Top with sliced tomato and a little feta after baking.
storage: Store baked breads airtight for 2 days; reheat in a hot oven.

title: Chinese Congee with Ginger Chicken
summary: Silky rice porridge simmered with ginger and shredded chicken, topped with spring onions and sesame oil.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse rice until water runs mostly clear.
Slice ginger and spring onions; cut chicken into two even pieces.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Combine rice, stock and ginger in a saucepan; simmer uncovered 45–55 minutes, stirring often, until grains break down.
Add chicken for the final 15–20 minutes and cook through.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove chicken and shred with forks.
Return to porridge, adjust thickness with hot water and season with soy; finish with spring onion and sesame oil.

tips: Stir the bottom regularly to prevent rice sticking as the porridge thickens.
variations: Use mushrooms and vegetable stock instead of chicken.
storage: Cool rapidly and refrigerate up to 2 days; reheat thoroughly, adding water.

title: Greek Pastitsio
summary: Baked pasta layered with cinnamon-scented beef ragù and a thick, golden béchamel topping.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 190°C.
Cook pasta 2 minutes short of packet directions; drain.
Whisk eggs lightly and grate cheese.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Brown onion and beef in oil for 10 minutes; add tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer 15 minutes.
Melt butter, stir in flour and gradually whisk in milk; cook until thick.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cool béchamel slightly, whisk in eggs and half the cheese.
Layer pasta, meat sauce and béchamel in a dish; top with cheese and bake 35–40 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes before slicing.

tips: Resting is essential for clean slices and a set béchamel.
variations: Use lamb mince for a richer, more traditional flavour.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze portions for up to 2 months; reheat thoroughly.

title: French Cassoulet-Inspired White Beans
summary: Creamy white beans baked with sausage, tomato and herbs beneath a crisp golden breadcrumb crust.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 190°C.
Drain beans, dice vegetables and slice sausages into large pieces.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Brown sausages in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes and set aside.
Soften onion and carrots in remaining oil for 8 minutes; add garlic, tomatoes, thyme, beans and stock.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Return sausages to the pan, simmer 10 minutes, then transfer to a baking dish.
Scatter breadcrumbs and bake uncovered 25 minutes until bubbling and golden.

tips: Keep some liquid around the beans; they absorb stock as they bake.
variations: Replace sausages with browned mushrooms and use vegetable stock.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 2 months; reheat thoroughly.

title: Portuguese Bacalhau a Bras
summary: Flakes of salted cod folded through golden matchstick potatoes, soft eggs, onion and parsley.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Use cod that has been thoroughly desalted according to supplier instructions.
Pat dry and flake, removing all bones; cut potatoes into thin matchsticks.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Fry potatoes in batches until golden and drain.
Soften onion in olive oil for 10 minutes, add garlic and cod, and cook 5 minutes until fish is opaque and flakes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Beat eggs lightly.
Fold potatoes into cod mixture, reduce heat and stir in eggs until softly set; finish with parsley and olives.

tips: Take pan off heat before eggs fully set to prevent dryness.
variations: Use thin oven-baked potato sticks instead of frying.
storage: Refrigerate promptly and consume within 1 day; reheat thoroughly.

title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Tofu Rice Bowls
summary: Crisp tofu with caramelised lemongrass and garlic over rice, cucumber and tangy lime dressing.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Press tofu for 15 minutes and cut into cubes.
Rinse rice and cook according to packet; slice cucumber and julienne carrot.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Mix lemongrass, garlic, soy and sugar.
Pan-fry tofu in oil 8–10 minutes until golden, then add lemongrass mixture and cook 2 minutes until fragrant.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Mix lime juice and vinegar with 1 tbsp water.
Divide rice among bowls, add tofu and fresh vegetables, and drizzle with dressing.

tips: Dry tofu thoroughly for a crisp crust before adding sauce.
variations: Replace tofu with sliced mushrooms for a different texture.
storage: Refrigerate rice and tofu separately within 1 hour and use within 1 day; reheat rice until steaming.

title: French Lentil Salad with Mustard
summary: Earthy green lentils tossed warm with sharp Dijon vinaigrette, shallots, parsley and crunchy celery.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils and place in saucepan with bay leaf and plenty of water.
Mince shallot and dice celery.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Simmer lentils 20–25 minutes until tender but intact; drain well.
Whisk mustard, vinegar and oil with salt and pepper.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Toss warm lentils with dressing so they absorb flavour, then fold in shallot, celery and parsley.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

tips: Avoid overcooking: lentils should retain their shape.
variations: Add crumbled goat cheese for creaminess.
storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days; refresh with a little vinegar before serving.

title: Mexican Elote Salad
summary: Sweet charred corn tossed with creamy lime dressing, chilli, coriander and salty cheese.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Remove husks and silk from corn.
Zest and juice lime; crumble cheese and chop coriander.

stages.title: Build the flavours
steps: Char corn in a hot dry skillet or on a grill for 10–12 minutes, turning until browned in patches.
Cool slightly and cut kernels from cobs.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Mix mayonnaise, sour cream, lime and chilli.
Toss with warm corn, scatter cheese and coriander over top and serve.

tips: Let corn char rather than constantly moving it for better smoky flavour.
variations: Use Greek yoghurt in place of sour cream.
storage: Refrigerate up to 2 days; best served soon after making.
